findings: At all three anchors and heldout, M1 delete retains conspicuous pink/cyan car-shaped residuals plus colored edge fragments; it is not a clean road.
All three frozen-appearance M2 delete arms retain the same conspicuous residual; no visually established continuous road restoration.

Position-only repair severely changes none/shift/rotate: broad gray-white haze or covering, blurred road/background, and changed vehicle color. At frame0 vehicle visibility is severely reduced. These bright areas are not reconstructed road.
Scale cap suppresses the broad position-only covering and preserves more scene structure, but none has extra colored edge noise and shift retains a new car plus the old car-shaped residual.
Rotate remains dominated by saturated green/red smears and fragmented shape for M1 and scale/split M2; it does not match the independent rotated car.
Split and position_scale are visually very similar at inspected resolution; there is no obvious positive split-specific visual outcome.
Heldout exhibits the same failure pattern; it is a fixed repaired frame8 replay, not generalization of a learned repair algorithm.
cannot_conclude: Images alone cannot establish unique Gaussian owners, exact mixed-support attribution, or shadow GT.
Frozen-appearance repair failure cannot establish that geometry repair is useless; appearance/covariance are inconsistent after relocation.
No mathematical upper bound, deployable algorithm, or real-scene generalization conclusion.

refit_visual_findings: M2 refit reduces none-view purple color shift and some colored boundary noise relative to frozen M2; original red vehicle appearance is partly recovered.
Compared with M1 refit, M2 refit still has additional colored edge fragments in none, including heldout; it does not visibly exceed the assignment baseline in original-view fidelity.
Delete still contains a large pink/cyan car silhouette at original car position in both refit arms; M2 has fewer peripheral speckles in places but no continuous road restoration.
Shift still shows displaced red car plus original-position pink/cyan residual in both arms.
Rotate remains a saturated green/red fragmented smear for both; M2 reduces the long bright leftward streak seen in M1 but does not recover a coherent rotated car.
Heldout reproduces these limited appearance improvements and major edit failures; no clean novel-camera editing result.
refit_interpretation: Negative result for this specific responsibility-plus-first-hit-moment repair, even after matched 200-update DC/opacity adaptation. Limited none appearance and peripheral-artifact improvements are real but do not resolve edit failure. Equal steps are not equal capacity (50712 vs 92540 parameters). This does not establish geometry repair is useless.
next_research_priority: Audit the car-shaped residual contributions that survive high-recall routing against independent surface/depth support, before adding more repair capacity: missing responsibility coverage is a direct unresolved bottleneck that local geometry/appearance operations on selected rows cannot remove.
